docs.notes:
Design basis per branch: 9 Dahua WizMind AI cameras (2 face recognition, 1 people counting, 2 drive-up vehicle, 4 customer-area domes), local AI NVR with 16 TB, staff alert screen and strobes, VPN link to one central Dahua DSS Pro V8 platform at head office – 108 cameras in total.
Face recognition, people counting, new vs returning customers, vehicle detection and alerts run natively on DSS Pro. The 30-second response-time report, 20-minute cleaning compliance and cross-branch visit history are delivered by the KPI integration & dashboard.
Cleaning monitoring verifies that staff visit each zone every cycle (camera presence + NFC check-in); camera AI cannot judge dust or surface cleanliness.
Minimum internet: 10 Mbps upload per branch, 150 Mbps at head office (static IP).
docs.terms:
Prices are valid for 15 days from the quotation date.
Payment: 50% advance with LPO, 40% on delivery of materials, 10% on testing & commissioning.
Implementation: approx. 16 weeks for all 12 branches, starting with a pilot branch.
Warranty: Dahua equipment as per manufacturer warranty; 1 year on workmanship and support. Annual maintenance from Year 2 quoted separately.
Software licences are perpetual.
Exclusions: internet lines & static IPs, civil works, pole foundations, core drilling, false-ceiling works, power points, authority fees.
Facial recognition of customers is biometric personal data; customer notice/signage and compliance with UAE PDPL are the client's responsibility.
